notes.title: Major Update and Halloween
notes.notes:
[b]A completely new game is already here. The game has changed the gameplay and plot.[/b]

The plot has been divided into chapters, and now you can get even more scared in the game.

Now you can play scared more than you expect.

[i]Am waiting for your assessment, comments and suggestions on the next chapter.[/i]

notes.title: New game
notes.notes:
Attention!

Thanks to everyone who played my game and appreciated it as it deserved. I apologize to everyone about the fact that the game was not originally released very well, but a new update will be released very soon. Major update, where will:

1. Other locations
2. A completely different plot
3. Different gameplay

A completely new game and completely modified.
